children: An on-chain analyst monitored an address that first bought GSTOCK two days ago and added to the position during a rapid 20-minute price surge. According to ChainCatcher, the address spent a total of $261,000 to accumulate 12.31 million GSTOCK at an average entry price of $0.02117.
The address is currently up $51,000 and ranks among the top four GSTOCK holders.

title: Address Buys 12.31 Million GSTOCK, Gains $51,000
